findings.title: Signs transactions with no time bounds, so issued signatures never expire
Role is stored but never enforced; any identity can delete the account registration or read it
Identity values are not validated, so mismatched phone or email entries silently never match
Account insert transaction never rolled back on error, leaking pooled DB connections
Server signing seed is accepted as a command-line flag, exposing it in argv and shell history
Network passphrase defaults to testnet, so a mainnet deployment that omits it signs for the wrong network
Startup continues when the database ping fails, so the server runs with a dead store
SEP-10 JWT issuer and audience are unchecked when the issuer flag is empty
Stellar signing secret in source
